mandatory_legal_checks: PoSH Act 2013 S.4 — Presiding Officer must be a senior woman; at least half the members women; one external member
PoSH Act 2013 S.6 — Local Committee route where fewer than ten employees, or where the complaint is against the employer
PoSH Act 2013 S.9 — complaint within three months, extendable by three more for reasons recorded in writing
PoSH Act 2013 S.10 — conciliation only at the aggrieved woman's request; no monetary settlement as its basis
PoSH Act 2013 S.11 — inquiry to be completed within ninety days; S.13 action within sixty days
PoSH Act 2013 S.12 — interim leave up to three months is IN ADDITION to entitled leave
PoSH Act 2013 S.14 — inability to substantiate a complaint is NOT a false complaint
PoSH Act 2013 S.16 — identities and proceedings must not be published
PoSH Act 2013 S.19 — the policy must be formulated AND widely disseminated
PoSH Act 2013 S.26 — non-compliance attracts a fine up to fifty thousand rupees
Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 S.75 — sexual harassment is also a criminal offence
